## Topics
- Writing a reproducible analysis report in Quarto
- Tables (gtsummary) and figure captions
- Parameterized reports: one template, many reports
- Project organization and package versions (renv)
- Final project presentations

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Produce a polished, fully reproducible Quarto report
- Render one report template for several counties or states
- Organize a project so someone else can rerun it

## Data
CDC PLACES county estimates (parameterized report); each team's project data

## Project

**Final presentations; written report due finals week**
